sentence: Researching this page found no federal or state proclamation, no congressional resolution, and no legal designation of any kind naming February 13 \"Galentine's Day.\" Sites like National Day Calendar list it on their February 13 page alongside other observances, but that listing reflects the site's own celebrations calendar, not any government or standards body recognizing the date; this calendar draws the same distinction on pages like [Talk Like a Pirate Day](/talk-like-a-pirate-day/), a rare comparison case that also traces to a single, fully named origin: two friends who invented it during a 1995 racquetball game, not any legislature.
